neighbours.label: token right before 'working memory' / 'short-term memory' in cognitive-psychology text (e.g. 'deficits in', 'holds information in')
fire: Children with ADHD often show clear deficits in working memory and attention.
The task measures how long people can hold a list of digits in working memory.
Without rehearsal, new information stays in short-term memory only briefly.
Stress reduces the capacity of working memory during difficult exams.
Older adults tend to perform worse on tests of working memory than students.
The prefrontal cortex keeps the phone number active in mind while you dial.
Training games claim to improve working memory, but the evidence is weak.
Anxiety uses up available cognitive resources needed for reasoning.
quiet: Children with asthma often show clear deficits in lung function and stamina.
The task measures how long people can hold a heavy weight above their heads.
Without watering, new seedlings stay small and wilt during the hot summer.
Stress reduces the strength of the immune system during long winters.
Older adults tend to perform worse on tests of grip strength than students.
The kitchen timer keeps the oven running while you prepare the salad.
Training programs claim to improve running speed, but the evidence is weak.
Drought uses up the available water needed for irrigating the fields.
